🚀 Full Stack Demo Application

This is a simple frontend-backend project built to demonstrate DevOps practices.

🔗 Backend Response:

{message}

📌 Project Information

  • Frontend: React.js
  • Backend: Node.js (Express)
  • API Endpoint: /api/message
  • Communication: REST API
  • Port: Frontend (3000), Backend (5000)

⚙️ DevOps Workflow

  1. Code written in VS Code
  2. Version control using Git
  3. Containerization using Docker
  4. CI/CD using Jenkins
  5. Deployment on cloud (AWS)

🎯 Purpose of This Project

This project is created to understand how frontend and backend interact, and how DevOps tools automate build, test, and deployment processes.
